# Hermite Interpolation 1D

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Sample the straight line y = 2x at 0.5 and 1.5. The interpolated ordinates are 1 and 3.

## What this example demonstrates

Sample the straight line y = 2x at 0.5 and 1.5. The interpolated ordinates are 1 and 3.
